# Vendored crates

## `chrono-tz` (#1118)

chrono-tz is unmaintained (RUSTSEC-2026-0555; the last release, 0.10.4, bundles
tzdata 2025b). Arrow and ORC still resolve zone names through it, so the
workspace patches it (`[patch.crates-io]` in the root `Cargo.toml`) with this
copy:

- every file is crates.io chrono-tz 0.10.4 unchanged, except `publish = false`
  in `Cargo.toml`, `tz/` and `src/prebuilt/`;
- `tz/` holds the IANA tzdata release named in `supply-chain/tzdata-version`,
  taken from `tzdata<version>.tar.gz` after checking its signature
  (`tzdata<version>.tar.gz.asc`, key `7E3792A9D8ACF7D633BC1588ED97E90E62AA7E34`);
- `src/prebuilt/` is generated by the crate's own codegen:
  `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<dir> cargo test --locked --test codegen` in this
  directory (the first run rewrites the files and fails; the second passes).

CI (`Vendored tzdata`) regenerates `src/prebuilt` and fails on any byte of
difference, and `scripts/tzdata-check.py` fails if `Cargo.lock` resolves
chrono-tz from crates.io or if `tz/` is not the pinned release. faucet-core's
tests fail unless this copy, jiff-tzdb and the pin name the same release and
give the same offsets.

To move to a new tzdata release, in one PR: bump `jiff-tzdb`, replace `tz/`,
regenerate `src/prebuilt/`, update `supply-chain/tzdata-version`, and list the
changed zones in the release notes. Delete this copy when `cargo tree -i
chrono-tz` is empty.
